name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: Group of native radios inside a fieldset and legend for picking one of several options.

props.name: name
props.description: The name attribute shared by every radio in the group.

props.name: options
props.description: List of options. The value is also used as part of the id.

props.name: label
props.description: Group title, rendered as the legend.

props.name: value / defaultValue / v-model / bind:value
props.description: Selected option. Blade and Astro use value, React value or defaultValue, Vue v-model, Svelte bind:value, Angular value or [(value)].

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: React only. Called with the value of the newly selected option.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Option layout: stacked or in a row.

props.name: id
props.description: Fieldset id, also the prefix of each radio id. Generated when empty.

a11y: Uses fieldset and legend, so the group title is announced when focus enters a radio.
Native radios: Tab moves to the selected option, arrow keys change the selection.
Option descriptions are linked to their radio through aria-describedby.

ai.whenToUse: Picking exactly one of two to five options that should all be visible, such as a subscription plan.
rules: Option values may only contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores because they are used in ids

id.description: Kelompok radio native dalam fieldset dan legend untuk memilih satu dari beberapa opsi.

props.name: Atribut name untuk semua radio di grup.
props.options: Daftar opsi. Value dipakai juga sebagai bagian id.
props.label: Judul grup, dirender sebagai legend.
props.onValueChange: Khusus React. Dipanggil dengan value opsi yang baru dipilih.
props.id: Id fieldset, juga awalan id tiap radio. Dibuat otomatis kalau kosong.
props.value / defaultValue / v-model / bind:va: Opsi terpilih. Blade dan Astro memakai value, React value atau defaultValue, Vue v-model, Svelte bind:value, Angular value atau [(value)].

a11y: Memakai fieldset dan legend sehingga judul grup dibacakan saat masuk ke radio.
Radio native: Tab masuk ke opsi terpilih, panah memindah pilihan.
Deskripsi opsi dihubungkan ke radio lewat aria-describedby.

ai.whenToUse: Memilih tepat satu dari dua sampai lima opsi yang perlu terlihat semua, misalnya paket langganan.
rules: Value opsi hanya huruf kecil, angka, tanda hubung, atau underscore karena dipakai sebagai id
